query: A support agent emailed a CSV of 1,200 customers to the wrong customer an hour ago. Names, emails, last 4 of card. Mix of EU and US. What now?
We got hit by ransomware last night. The attackers say they took the student database. We host it for districts in New York and California.
Our helpdesk vendor says they had unauthorized access to tickets in September and just told us.
An employee's laptop was stolen from their car. It had an unencrypted export of payroll data.
Our support chatbot showed one customer's order history to another customer.
Do we have to notify anyone? Someone accessed an S3 bucket but we don't think they downloaded anything.
A customer asked us to delete their data.
Review the breach notification clause in Acme's DPA.
Which states have 30-day breach notification deadlines now?
